ncEmptyHint: Drop GameObjects or Materials into the field above to begin.
ncDropZoneTooltip: Drop multiple objects — lilToon materials are detected automatically
ncOutputFolderTooltip: Leave blank to save next to the source material
ncAssignToRendererTooltip: Assign the converted material onto the source renderers (undoable)
ncConvertSelectedTooltip: Create NonToon material assets for selected items and assign to renderers
ncForceRenderingModeTooltip: Override auto-detection of rendering mode from lilToon shader name
ncCopyRenderQueueTooltip: Copy source renderQueue verbatim. OFF = mode-derived queue (Opaque=-1, Cutout=2450, Transparent=3000)
ncNoLilToonFound: No lilToon materials found. Drop GameObjects or Materials above.
ncNoSelection: Select at least one material to convert.
ncNoShader: NonToon shader not found. Ensure jp.lilxyzw.nontoon package is installed.
ncFeatColorTint: Main color tint (_Color) — NonToon has no base tint
ncFeatBacklightColor: Backlight color (NonToon backlight has no color property)
ncFeatMaskTextures: Per-feature mask textures (use NonToon's _SharedMask RGBA channels manually)
ncOutputFolderMustBeAssets: The custom output folder must be inside this project's Assets folder.
ncOutputFolderInvalidPath: The custom output folder contains an invalid path segment.
ncOutputFolderStreamingAssets: Unity cannot create material assets inside StreamingAssets. Choose another Assets folder.
ncOutputFolderFileCollision: A file already occupies part of the requested output path: {0}
ncBakeMainTexTooltip: Composite Color, HSVG, and 2nd/3rd layers into one texture with lilToon's baker
ncBakeAlphaMaskTooltip: Bake the active lilToon alpha mask into the base texture's alpha channel when transparency and cutoff are within usable ranges
ncBakeShadowTooltip: Create an editable Shader Core .scgradients asset from lilToon shadow color
ncBakeEmissionTooltip: Transfer HDR color, alpha, Blend, and texture strength through an editable SharedMask. This works best with lilToon Add mode; the color remains grayscale.
ncBakeNormalMapTooltip: Re-bake normal map when tiling/offset is non-default
ncBakeMasksTooltip: Create a Shader Core .scmask and link source textures or required composite bakes to its RGBA slots
ncBakeAtOwnRisk: Baked results may require manual adjustment.
ncConvertFurTooltip: Convert lilToon Fur materials to NonToonFur. OFF leaves Fur materials completely unconverted (they stay lilToon).
ncAllSelectedAreFur: All selected materials are Fur materials, and Convert Fur is off in Advanced Settings — nothing to convert.
ncConvertSkippedFur: Skipped Fur materials: {0} (Convert Fur is off; they remain lilToon).
